name: Emergency braking at 4 speeds (also with the car 25% faster than calibrated)
detail: no contact in 8 runs, smallest gap 10.0 cm, top speed tested 1.12 m/s

name: Throttle-cut roll-out: simulator vs the real car
detail: real car rolled 1-7 cm at 0.25-0.36 m/s; simulator 3-5 cm in that range (limit 12 cm)

name: Failsafes: controller lost, Pi dies, LiDAR unplugged, link delay
detail: LiDAR unplugged at speed: stopped 93 cm short; watchdog stops the car; Link delay rises to 150 ms: stopped 10 cm short; Controller disconnects at full speed: stopped 93 cm short; Pi program dies (ESP32 failsafe): motor -200 -> 0 within 0.8 s of the last command

rows.name: LiDAR unplugged at speed
rows.detail: stopped 93 cm short; watchdog stops the car

rows.name: Pi program dies (ESP32 failsafe)
rows.detail: motor -200 -> 0 within 0.8 s of the last command

name: Intent-aware warning catches more hazards than physics-only at <= 4 false alarms/min
detail: <= 2 false alarms/min: physics 0%, blend 0%, adaptive 44%; <= 4 false alarms/min: physics 0%, blend 0%, adaptive 57%; <= 8 false alarms/min: physics 93%, blend 75%, adaptive 67%

name: Follow-the-leader: holds a gap, and does not hit a leader that stops dead
detail: steady gap 61 cm (+/-1.3); leader stops: closest approach 20 cm, no contact

name: Obstacle bypass: rejoins the line, or refuses a gap that is too narrow
detail: 60/60 correct, 0 contacts, median final lateral error 0.6 cm (95th 1.6), median clearance 6.7 cm
